prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a head-on impact, and our client has since sought medical treatment for injuries that are ongoing. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, as well as any additional coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists for your insured.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes, without limitation, the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, repair and total-loss estimates, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Destruction or alteration of any such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
